Two disciplines from the track’s contract govern how far such statements may be pushed, and they are the reason this paper’s claims stop where they do. The first is the reverse-engineering caveat. For any potential one can define an entropy whose gradient reproduces the corresponding force, so an entropic account earns content only when the entropy is computed from an independently specified ensemble and coarse-graining, with the target law nowhere inserted. The second is the anti-circularity contract that binds every run reported here. The ensembles, projections, measures, counts, and fit alternatives were declared before the runs, the forbidden-input list excludes any inserted area proportionality or target law, and a construction that obtained its scaling by insertion would void the run rather than pass the gate. The boundary-limited arm exists precisely to demonstrate the nearest temptation, an area law that is an artifact of access rather than a property of the ensemble, and the audit arm of the mechanism run exists to catch the corresponding temptation for determinism. Nothing here supports or undermines any entropic account of real gravity. What is established is which mechanism classes could never have supplied the states such accounts assume, and which class provably could, in models where every bit is countable.

IX. METHODS AND REPRODUCIBILITY

All instruments derive from the campaign’s sealed tolerance and instrument freezes, which fix numerical bars in advance and void themselves if edited, and the projection-entropy stack extends the published fold instruments [5] and the completed entropy track [6]. The operational-count decision and its dynamical corollary were recorded in the track document before the corresponding runs, and the forbidden-input list of the track’s anti-circularity contract applies to every construction reported here. Every result-bearing run writes an appendonly JSON evidence record containing the complete declared parameter set, outcome arrays, and a canonical SHA-256 hash of the record body. The records for this paper are eg0-instrument.json and eg1-area-gate.json in the campaign repository, both carrying the exploratory label of the campaign’s evidence-grading scheme, and the mechanism run binds to eg1b-mechanism.json. The instrument layer is unsealed pending the campaign’s crosssubstrate replication clause, and its Python implementation is the reference. Every number and every figure coordinate in this paper is read from those committed records or is an exact closed form derived in the text, with the figure table generated deterministically by a committed script with no free parameters. A reducer may summarize records but may not rewrite them.
